giant_spider.name: Giant Spider
giant_spider.description: A massive cave spider with a low, forward-facing silhouette, a plated dark-brown abdomen, an almost black cephalothorax, copper-jointed angular legs, ivory chelicerae, and a threatening cluster of ruby-red eyes.

goblin_skirmisher.name: Goblin Skirmisher
goblin_skirmisher.description: A short, wiry goblin crouches beneath an oversized bald olive-green head, with long horizontal ears, a heavy brow, narrow red-orange eyes, a broad nose, and two lower ivory tusks framing its snarl. A ragged brown leather tunic and loincloth wrap the compact torso beneath a diagonal strap with a square iron buckle, while a studded right shoulder pad, wrist bindings, and shin wraps provide scavenged protection. Its right hand grips a single crude notched short sword of rusty gray iron and brown leather, while the free four-fingered hand spreads for balance above broad bare green feet. Yellow-green highlights from the upper left sharpen the agile silhouette against deep moss shadows and worn umber leather.

goblin_hexer.name: Goblin Hexer
goblin_hexer.description: A short, hunched goblin occultist peers from a pointed deep-plum hood, its olive-green face compressed between long ears, glowing red eyes, a wrinkled nose, and two lower ivory tusks. Ragged purple robes form broad torn sleeves and layered tails over brown leather wraps and wide bare feet. Bone teeth hang across the chest, while small skulls mark the shoulder, sternum, and waist like crude talismans. Its left hand grips a crooked wooden staff crowned by a pale skull, bound bones, and attached plum ribbons; the open right palm shapes a compact violet hex flame. Pale lilac magic and upper-left bone highlights stand sharply against the dark plum cloth and moss-green shadows.

orc_raider.name: Orc Raider
orc_raider.description: A stocky moss-green raider with yellow eyes, ivory tusks, a short dark crest, worn asymmetrical leather and iron armor, a single spiked pauldron, bone trophies at the belt, and a broad notched crescent axe.

orc_berserker.name: Orc Berserker
orc_berserker.description: A massive hunched berserker with olive-green skin, ember-red eyes, ivory tusks, a roaring scarred face, a short dark-red crest, patched rust-red leather, spiked iron plates, heavy wrappings, and an enormous chipped two-handed axe.

kobold_trapper.name: Kobold Trapper
kobold_trapper.description: A small wiry rust-red reptilian trapper with a long toothy snout, amber eye, backward dark head spines, a ragged hide hood, leather straps and pouches, a barbed dagger, a coiled snare rope, clawed feet, and a long counterbalancing tail.

kobold_sparkmage.name: Kobold Sparkmage
kobold_sparkmage.description: A small rust-red reptilian caster with a long toothy snout, backward head spines, cyan-glowing eyes, ragged brown leather mage robes, copper charms, clawed feet, a long tail, and blue-white electrical arcs crawling over both bare hands.

gnoll_hunter.name: Gnoll Hunter
gnoll_hunter.description: A tall lean hyena humanoid with mottled ochre-brown fur, a dark bristled mane, pointed ears, an amber eye, a long fanged muzzle, crude rawhide and bone gear, a scratched round wooden shield, a dark-tipped hunting spear, and digitigrade clawed feet.

gnoll_bonecaller.name: Gnoll Bonecaller
gnoll_bonecaller.description: A hunched ochre-brown hyena shaman with a dark bristled mane, long fanged muzzle, worn hide garments, tooth and bone amulets, digitigrade claws, a twisted skull-and-bone ritual focus, and sickly emerald spirit flame around both the focus and free hand.

wight_knight.name: Wight Knight
wight_knight.description: A tall rigid undead knight enclosed in blackened blue-steel plate armor, with a pointed closed helm and violet eye slit, layered gorget and pauldrons, a clawed gauntlet, a shredded near-black purple cloak, and a broad spectral Graveblade with an icy cyan core and magenta-violet edges.

ghoul_stalker.name: Ghoul Stalker
ghoul_stalker.description: A feral hunched undead predator with taut ash-gray cadaver skin, a scarred bald skull, sparse stringy black hair, pointed ears, glowing amber eyes, a broad fanged mouth, extremely long arms, oversized clawed hands and feet, bent legs, ragged brown burial wraps, and a decayed hide shroud.

zombie_brute.name: Zombie Brute
zombie_brute.description: A colossal asymmetrical undead brute with leathery gray-brown cadaver skin, a scarred bald head, sparse dark hair, milky eyes, broken yellow teeth, swollen shoulders, enormous arms and fists, a ragged slate-blue tabard, torn brown trousers and wraps, a heavy belt, broken wrist chains, and massive bare feet.

shadow_imp.name: Shadow Imp
shadow_imp.description: A small wiry fiend with near-black violet reptilian skin, tall ridged horns, long pointed ears, glowing magenta eyes, thin sharp teeth, elongated claws, a ragged bat wing, a curled tail, a torn brown loincloth, metal bands, and luminous purple shadow flame clinging to its body.

brimstone_imp.name: Brimstone Imp
brimstone_imp.description: A small muscular fiend covered in rust-red scales cracked with ember-orange light, with a crown of ridged horns and spikes, long pointed ears, glowing amber eyes, serrated teeth, black-tipped claws, one ragged red bat wing, a burning spined tail, brown wraps, and a skull-charmed loincloth.

lesser_demon.name: Lesser Demon
lesser_demon.description: A tall muscular fiend with dark rust-red scales cracked by molten orange veins, massive curved black horns, facial spikes, glowing orange eyes, a broad fanged maw, one enormous ragged wing, long black claws, cloven hooves, a bladed spined tail, iron bracers, chains, skull trophies, and a torn black loincloth.

forest_sprite.name: Forest Sprite
forest_sprite.description: A tiny wiry forest fae with warm bark-like skin, amber eyes, a mischievous smile, enormous pointed ears, olive leaf hair crowned by twig antlers, four translucent gold-veined wings, layered leaf garments, vine wraps, twig-like clawed feet, and a short thorny branch focus.

pixie_trickster.name: Pixie Trickster
pixie_trickster.description: A tiny feminine fae duelist with warm skin, long pointed ears, violet eyes, a sly smile, short swept purple hair, curled blue antennae with gold fittings, four translucent blue-lilac wings, a blue feather collar, a purple petal outfit, curled boots, gold bells and gems, and a slim silver needle dagger.

satyr_duelist.name: Satyr Duelist
satyr_duelist.description: A lean athletic satyr with warm tan skin, swept dark-brown hair, matching sideburns and goatee, pointed ears, amber eyes, curling segmented ram horns, an ornate brown-and-gold leather vest and bracers, rolled pale sleeves, layered belts, a long gold-trimmed purple sash, shaggy goat legs, cloven hooves, and a slim silver rapier.

dryad_thornweaver.name: Dryad Thornweaver
dryad_thornweaver.description: A lithe female tree spirit with copper-brown bark anatomy, luminous yellow-green eyes, pointed ears, a crown of bare branching antlers, tangled olive foliage, small white flowers, a layered leaf skirt, rooted claw-like feet, an elongated branch-claw, and a living thorn whip coiled in her right hand.

fae_blade_dancer.name: Fae Blade Dancer
fae_blade_dancer.description: An athletic female fae with warm tan skin, bright blue eyes, very long pointed ears, voluminous violet hair, four translucent blue-lilac veined wings, ornate deep-blue and silver leaf-filigree armor, purple-gold ribbon streamers, armored bark-brown lower legs, and two matching silver crescent blades set with blue gems.

dire_wolf.name: Dire Wolf
dire_wolf.description: An enormous low-slung wolf with charcoal-gray and deep-brown fur, a heavy black-brown spiked mane over its head and spine, fierce amber eyes, pale gray-beige muzzle and brow markings, a broad black nose, ivory teeth, lighter muscular forelegs, oversized splayed paws with long black claws, dark hindquarters, and a thick heavy tail.

owlbear_cub.name: Owlbear Cub
owlbear_cub.description: A compact juvenile owlbear with a hulking russet-brown bear body, a dense mantle of layered tawny feathers over its head, shoulders, and spine, a round cream-and-cinnamon owl facial disk, fierce amber eyes, pointed ear tufts, a glossy black hooked beak, thick muscular legs, broad splayed paws, and oversized black claws.

cave_troll.name: Cave Troll
cave_troll.description: An enormous hunched cave troll with gray stone-like skin armored in irregular boulder scales, knobs, and small dorsal spikes, a coarse black-brown mane, narrowed amber eyes, pointed ears, a broad flattened nose, two long ivory lower tusks, massive shoulders, elongated clawed arms, thick bent legs, wide three-toed feet, ragged hide and rope wrappings, a bone-and-skull necklace, and a heavy knotted wooden club with a bulbous spiked head.

hill_giant_youth.name: Hill Giant Youth
hill_giant_youth.description: A towering young hill giant with a broad, heavily muscled frame, weathered tan-ochre skin, a stern square face beneath a heavy brow, pointed ears, a shaggy dark-brown mane with two beaded front braids, a stitched and ragged brown hide tunic with a rough shoulder pelt, rope belt and limb wraps, a leather pouch, a tooth necklace, oversized bare five-toed feet, and one immense two-handed maul made from a wooden trunk capped by a single irregular gray boulder lashed in thick rope.

minotaur_guardian.name: Minotaur Guardian
minotaur_guardian.description: A massive bull-headed guardian with dense dark-brown fur, a thick black-brown mane and beard, fierce amber eyes, a broad bovine muzzle pierced by a gold nose ring, two long symmetrical ivory-brown horns curling upward and outward, pointed bull ears, cloven hooves, and a visible tufted tail. Ornate aged-bronze armor engraved with angular labyrinth motifs covers the chest, asymmetric right shoulder, forearms, belt, and lower legs above a layered leather war skirt, while one ceremonial long-shafted labyrinth axe carries an elaborate double-bladed steel head with bronze geometric fittings.

ogre_marauder.name: Ogre Marauder
ogre_marauder.description: An enormous hunched ogre with pale olive-beige warty skin, massively muscled long arms, oversized hands, broad bare five-toed feet, a mostly bald knobbled scalp beneath a swept-back dark-brown crest, pointed ears, amber eyes, a flattened nose, two long lower ivory tusks, and uneven smaller teeth. A ragged brown leather-and-fur tunic, torn rust-red loincloth, diagonal spiked leather harness, heavy bracers, belt pouches, bone charms, and a skull pendant mark him as a brutal marauder, while one two-handed maul combines a leather-wrapped wooden shaft with a single irregular gray boulder locked inside a riveted, spiked dark-iron cage.

lizardfolk_scout.name: Lizardfolk Scout
lizardfolk_scout.description: An athletic upright reptilian scout with olive-ochre scales broken by dark slate plate markings, a broad low snout, one visible amber slit-pupil eye beneath a ridged brow, a swept line of brown-gold hornlike spines running from the skull down the back and long muscular tail, digitigrade legs, and broad clawed hands and feet. Weathered brown leather armor combines a heavy right pauldron, diagonal buckled chest harness, bracers, ragged waist panels, and wrapped lower legs, while exactly one long wooden javelin carries a lashed angular gray spearhead and fiber ties, and one round wooden shield bears a rope-bound rim, pale chevron-and-diamond pattern, and central iron boss.

naga_apprentice.name: Naga Apprentice
naga_apprentice.description: A feminine naga apprentice with a scaled humanoid upper torso, exactly two clawed arms, and no legs above one long dark bronze-olive serpent body looped into a broad ground coil, with pale segmented belly plates and one curling tail tip. Her refined dragonlike face has amber eyes, a swept crown of hornlike gold-brown head fins, a blue diamond forehead gem, and dark indigo-black back fins or hair bound with gold beads and torn purple ribbons. Layered violet robes with narrow gold trim form a crossed bodice, tattered sleeve scarves, and ragged skirt panels around gold armbands, bracers, an ornate belt and collar set with blue gems, and several potion vials, while cyan-white arcane flame gathers over one open palm.

yuan_ti_cutthroat.name: Yuan-ti Cutthroat
yuan_ti_cutthroat.description: A hooded serpent assassin with an olive-bronze scaled humanoid torso, exactly two clawed arms, and no legs above one heavy snake body coiled on the ground, its pale tan belly plates ending in a single curled tail tip. A long narrow reptilian face peers from a charcoal-black hood with one visible amber slit-pupil eye and a short purple forked tongue, while a torn gold-trimmed cowl and layered split tunic sit beneath brown leather straps, buckles, belts, and bracers. An angular gold belt emblem, one attached green poison vial, and one brown pouch accompany exactly one broad curved silver knife with a wavy engraved groove, ornate gold guard, and ring pommel.

basilisk_hatchling.name: Basilisk Hatchling
basilisk_hatchling.description: A squat six-legged basilisk hatchling with three pairs of broad clawed feet, a low armored body, and one thick muscular tail curled upward into a tight loop. Overlapping dark olive-gray scales cover its back and limbs like weathered stone plates, while pale bronze-tan segments protect the throat and underside. Its wedge-shaped head ends in a hooked stone-hard beak above a tooth-lined jaw and dark tongue, with one visible amber slit-pupil eye beneath a heavy brow. Uneven hornlike brown spikes frame the forehead and cheeks, rise into a tall jagged dorsal ridge, and taper along the back and tail.

harpy_screecher.name: Harpy Screecher
harpy_screecher.description: A lean female avian humanoid with exactly two clawed arms, two enormous feathered wings rising separately from her upper back, two digitigrade bird legs ending in broad hooked talons, and no tail. Her gaunt tan face has long pointed ears, fierce amber eyes, a hooked gray beaklike nose, and a snarling tooth-lined mouth beneath a wild windswept mane of dark brown hair. Layered umber, brown, charcoal, and gray feathers cover the wings, shoulders, hips, and lower legs, while ragged olive-green cloth wraps her chest and waist beneath amber bead necklaces and belts, with a single pale feather charm at her hip.

griffin_fledgling.name: Griffin Fledgling
griffin_fledgling.description: A compact young griffin combining an eagle's head and forequarters with a tawny lion's body. A swept crown and deep layered breast ruff shift from bright ivory to warm cream around fierce amber eyes, a golden cere, and a heavy charcoal-black hooked beak. Exactly two powerful eagle forelegs end in oversized black-tipped talons, while two muscular lion hind legs support the golden-ochre haunches. Two enormous back wings layer burnished gold, chestnut, and dark umber flight feathers above one long curling lion tail tipped by a single dark featherlike tuft.

manticore_whelp.name: Manticore Whelp
manticore_whelp.description: A compact juvenile manticore with a low muscular lion body, exactly four broad clawed paws, two small batlike wings, and one heavily armored scorpion tail ending in a single curved stinger. Its angular tawny feline face glares through amber eyes above a broad dark nose and four prominent ivory fangs, framed by pointed ears and a dense swept mane of deep brown hornlike tufts. Irregular dark stripes and spots break the ochre-gold coat, while the wings carry red-black membranes over hooked brown fingers and the tail forms a chain of glossy dark-crimson plates.

wyvern_juvenile.name: Wyvern Juvenile
wyvern_juvenile.description: A compact juvenile dragon-like wyvern with a low four-legged stance, two broad leathery wings, and one long muscular tail ending in a single hooked stinger. Its narrow horned skull carries an amber slit-pupil eye, a hooked beaklike snout, and a tooth-lined jaw beneath layered dark brow plates. Overlapping moss-olive and weathered bronze scales armor the limbs and torso, while pale tan segments protect the long curved throat and belly. Jagged near-black spines sweep from the crown down the neck and back, and warm brown wing membranes stretch between bronze-scaled fingers above four heavy clawed feet.

dragon_wyrmling.name: Dragon Wyrmling
dragon_wyrmling.description: A compact juvenile red dragon with a low four-legged stance, two broad leathery wings, and one thick tapering tail curled beside its haunches. Two long swept ivory-gold horns crown its wedge-shaped head above smaller brow and cheek spikes, a fierce amber slit-pupil eye, and a tooth-lined jaw glowing with stray embers. Dense overlapping crimson and dark ruby scales armor the neck, shoulders, limbs, and tail, while pale bronze-gold segments protect the throat and belly. Jagged red-gold spines run from the crown along the back, and deep red-brown wing membranes stretch between bright crimson fingers above four heavy black-clawed feet.

elemental_spark.name: Elemental Spark
elemental_spark.description: A small floating elemental formed entirely from angular blue-white lightning around a sharp masklike face. Two solid white eyes glare from a pale cyan core beneath a crown of tall branching bolts, while deep cobalt edges give each discharge a hard crystalline silhouette. Exactly two long electrical arms branch from the core into three-pronged claw shapes, and a fork of curling energy tendrils replaces legs beneath the face. Sparse bright sparks orbit the crown and shoulders, while near-white channels flare through cyan, royal blue, and navy layers across the otherwise weightless body.

fire_elemental_ling.name: Fire Elemental Ling
fire_elemental_ling.description: A compact humanoid elemental built from layered ribbons of living fire. A tall swept crown of flame rises from a sharp ember-red face with two solid white-yellow almond eyes, while a narrow white-hot core twists through its chest. Exactly two long flame arms end in three hooked claw tongues, and two bent legs terminate in grounded three-pronged feet without clothing, armor, or a weapon. Pale yellow channels flare through golden-orange limbs and a bright central body, shifting through deep orange and red to dark crimson along the outer and lower edges. Curled flame tips around the shoulders, forearms, hips, and crown give the otherwise lean creature a restless, predatory silhouette.

ice_elemental_ling.name: Ice Elemental Ling
ice_elemental_ling.description: A compact humanoid elemental assembled from interlocking blades of blue-white ice. A tall asymmetric crown of crystalline spires rises above a wedge-shaped face with two luminous pale-cyan almond eyes, while a bright diamond-shaped core glows at the center of its chest. Exactly two articulated arms taper through layered frost plates into three long hooked talons, and two bent legs end in broad three-pronged shard feet. White facets and translucent cyan planes catch the light across the crown, shoulders, forearms, and shins, stepping through sky blue and royal blue to deep cobalt and navy edges. Smaller spikes sweep backward from its cheeks, spine, elbows, and heels, giving the unarmed creature a jagged, predatory silhouette.

earth_elemental_ling.name: Earth Elemental Ling
earth_elemental_ling.description: A short, broad juvenile earth elemental built from interlocking tan and umber boulders. A crown of jagged stone spires rises from its heavy wedge-shaped brow and continues along its craggy back, framing two bright amber eyes set deep in a mouthless rock face. Exactly two massive layered fists hang from thick articulated arms, while two rooted legs end in broad three-toed stone feet. Twisted woody roots bind the shoulders, torso, forearms, hips, and shins, with muted olive moss packed into the deepest crevices. Pale sandstone facets catch the upper-left light across its crown, knuckles, shoulders, and toes before descending through warm ochre and dark brown to nearly black fissures, giving the unarmed creature a compact, ancient, and immovable silhouette.

air_elemental_ling.name: Air Elemental Ling
air_elemental_ling.description: A small hovering elemental woven entirely from layered ribbons of white and icy-blue wind. Its mouthless mask-like face narrows to a sharp chin beneath a tall swept crest of curling air, with two luminous cyan almond eyes cutting through the pale currents. Exactly two long arms spiral outward into broad hands tipped by hooked wind talons, while the creature has no legs or feet; its torso tightens into a tapered tornado tail below the waist. Wide looping streamers circle the shoulders, forearms, waist, and lower vortex as continuous bands, giving the weightless body a restless corkscrew silhouette. Near-white upper-left highlights travel through frost blue and clear cyan into royal-blue folds and deep cobalt edges, making the face, claws, and concentric airflow readable against dark surroundings.

dark_elf_assassin.name: Dark Elf Assassin
dark_elf_assassin.description: A lean, low-crouched dark elf killer with charcoal-gray skin, long knife-edged ears, and straight silver-white hair spilling from a deep plum hood. Two narrow magenta eyes glare above a black cloth mask that hides the lower face. Worn violet-black leather and blackened bronze plates reinforce the chest, one prominent engraved pauldron, segmented forearm guards, thighs, knees, and claw-toed boots. A ragged asymmetric cloak and split coat tails stream behind the figure, while belts carry dark pouches, a short chain, and a single red jewel. Exactly two gloved hands hold matching curved assassin daggers with hooked cold-silver blades, ornate bronze guards, and small crimson gems. Pale hair and blade edges catch the upper-left light over muted plum, tarnished copper, brown-black leather, and deep violet shadows, creating a compact predatory silhouette built for sudden double-blade strikes.

dark_elf_arcanist.name: Dark Elf Arcanist
dark_elf_arcanist.description: A tall, lean dark elf spellcaster with charcoal-gray skin, a severe angular face, long knife-edged ears, and straight silver-white hair swept over blackened shoulder plates. Narrow violet eyes burn beneath a bronze circlet set with a small purple gem. Layered violet-black robes, a torn plum mantle, engraved bronze trim, armored knees, claw-toed boots, crossing belts, dark pouches, short chains, and crystal-stoppered phials form a ragged ceremonial silhouette. The left gloved hand grips one tall twisted blackwood staff crowned by a faceted violet crystal between hooked bronze prongs and two hanging crystal charms. The open right hand shapes a compact black-violet void core ringed with electric lavender flame. Pale hair, crystal facets, and magic catch the upper-left light over muted plum cloth, tarnished bronze, charcoal skin, and near-black folds, making the arcanist readable as a disciplined battlefield caster rather than a robed civilian.

dwarven_ghost.name: Dwarven Ghost
dwarven_ghost.description: A short, broad ancestral dwarf spirit with a stern square face, luminous cyan eyes, swept-back blue-white hair, and an immense forked beard divided into two bound braids around a flowing central mass. A silver runic circlet with a diamond brow stone crowns his head. Dark blue-black dwarven plate covers his compact frame in layered pauldrons, engraved bracers, geometric belt plates, reinforced knees, and heavy boots, while torn spectral cloth and attached cyan wisps trail from the armor and beard. Both gauntleted hands control one massive square double-faced warhammer with spiral runes, beveled steel edges, and a dark wrapped haft. Cold white highlights and an electric cyan rim catch the upper-left light against deep navy metal, preserving the weight of an armored hammer warrior inside an unmistakably spectral silhouette.

cursed_paladin.name: Cursed Paladin
cursed_paladin.description: A tall fallen holy warrior sealed inside complete dark gunmetal plate with tarnished bronze-gold trim. A closed angular great helm rises to a broken spike and hides the face behind one narrow violet visor slit. Broad layered pauldrons, a segmented breastplate, armored fauld, gauntlets, greaves, and heavy sabatons create a rigid fortress silhouette beneath a torn black-violet mantle. The left arm carries a large kite shield with a thick bronze rim and prominent bronze cross, while the right hand grips one long jagged sword whose dark blade is edged by continuous purple curse flame. Muted silver highlights catch the upper-left light across near-black steel and old bronze, while restrained violet seams and attached spectral fire reveal the oath-corruption within the otherwise disciplined paladin armor.

enchanted_armor.name: Enchanted Armor
enchanted_armor.description: A tall empty suit of animated plate with no flesh, face, or bones inside. A pointed closed helmet frames one broad cyan visor above layered dark-gunmetal and aged-bronze breastplates, oversized rounded pauldrons, articulated gauntlets, fauld plates, greaves, and heavy sabatons. A narrow navy tabard with a gold vertical device hangs from the waist. Brilliant cyan enchantment shines through the hollow neck and visor, binds the shoulder, elbow, waist, and knee gaps, and gathers into one attached swirling plume between and behind the legs. Warm bronze edges catch the upper-left light against near-black steel while electric blue seams expose the magic holding the otherwise weaponless armor together.

crystal_golem.name: Crystal Golem
crystal_golem.description: An enormous broad humanoid construct assembled from dark violet-gray stone joints and interlocking blue crystal. One tall faceted cyan-blue prism forms its head above a cold narrow eye slit, while a huge diamond-shaped crystal core dominates the chest. Violet amethyst and cobalt shards rise in layered clusters across the shoulders, back, forearms, knees, and calves. Exactly two massive arms terminate in oversized multi-prism fists, and two heavy legs end in broad clustered crystal feet. Pale blue-white facet highlights catch the upper-left light against deep indigo shadows, making the golem read as a single dense mineral body rather than armor, clothing, or a living giant.

lich_acolyte.name: Lich Acolyte
lich_acolyte.description: A tall, gaunt skeletal occultist stares from the shadow of a pointed charcoal hood, its tan skull and deep sockets lit by cold green-cyan glints. Layered forest-green and near-black robes fall in wide sleeves and a long ragged hem, reinforced by tarnished bronze shoulder plates, clasps, bracers, and a belt of small skull ornaments. Its left hand grips a dark ceremonial staff whose bronze forked cage cradles an attached green-cyan ghostflame, while its open right palm shapes the same necrotic light. Dark boots, short gold-green trim, and pale upper-left highlights keep the narrow undead silhouette readable against the heavy robe mass.
